rows.acceptance_criterion: The promoted biological packet reproduces the declared measurable signatures on held-out datasets without widening the claim boundary.
rows.falsifier_specification: If the bounded signature family fails on held-out datasets, the biological packet remains frontier-bound.

rows.acceptance_criterion: Declared chemistry benchmark families pass the tolerance envelope on held-out compounds or reactions.
rows.falsifier_specification: A held-out thermochemical, spectral, or kinetic family outside tolerance collapses the promoted chemistry packet.

rows.acceptance_criterion: No replay divergence and no surviving counterexample against the promoted packet.
rows.falsifier_specification: A single replay divergence or surviving counterexample collapses promotion for the affected packet.

rows.acceptance_criterion: Held-out residuals stay inside the declared tolerance band for every promoted benchmark family.
rows.falsifier_specification: Any benchmark family with residuals outside tolerance or with broken sign/order constraints falsifies the promoted packet.

rows.acceptance_criterion: Declared trajectory and regime-change observables remain inside tolerance on held-out intervals.
rows.falsifier_specification: A missed turning point or out-of-band held-out trajectory falsifies the promoted systems packet.
